headline: EICMA public day and SIRM congress on a rainy Friday; easyJet cabin crew strike all day
taxi: Rho Fiera all day, heaviest at 18:30 closing; CityLife at congress close; centre Friday evening, busier with the rain.
linate: Busy: SIRM delegates and EICMA visitors; easyJet cancellations possible (07:00–10:00 and 18:00–21:00 flights protected).

headline: EICMA Saturday at Rho (biggest crowd), SIRM congress and Nayt at Assago
taxi: Rho Fiera all day, peak at 18:30 closing; Assago exits around 23:30; centre Saturday night.
linate: Busy: weekend EICMA visitors; SIRM delegates starting to leave.

headline: Last EICMA and SIRM day plus Inter – Como at 18:00
taxi: Rho Fiera at 18:30 closing; San Siro arrivals 16:30–18:00 and exits 20:00–21:00.
linate: Busy evening departures as EICMA and SIRM visitors fly home.

headline: Italo rail strike 09:01–16:59 and Pitbull at Unipol Dome Santa Giulia
taxi: Centrale and Garibaldi stations as Italo passengers switch; Santa Giulia exits around 23:00.
linate: Some extra demand from travellers dropping Italo trains for flights.

headline: Quiet day: no big fair, match or arena show
taxi: Normal weekday demand, a little more with drizzle; theatre exits in the centre around 23:00.

headline: Architect@Work and Forum Retail open at MiCo, Tokio Hotel at Assago
taxi: CityLife at show closing; Assago exits around 23:00.
linate: Some extra business arrivals for the trade shows.

headline: Last day of Architect@Work and Forum Retail; eve of Friday's ATM strike
taxi: CityLife at show closing; otherwise normal weekday demand, more in the evening ahead of the strike.

headline: ATM strike: metro, bus and tram at risk 08:45–15:00 and after 18:00; Blue at Assago
taxi: Very high all day outside 15:00–18:00; long queues at stations and in the centre; Assago exits around 23:00.
linate: Hard to reach by M4 outside guaranteed bands; allow extra time or book a taxi early.
